hook: April 2008. Ford's new quad-cam Boss finally out-muscles the SS by 20 kW. And they're just $200 apart.
cta: VE SS or FG XR8? Pick a side 👇

stories.a: Big cubes, more torque and two extra airbags for $200 less.
stories.b: Boss 290 brought more power, a bonnet bulge and a muffler that opens up.
stories.take: Ford won the kilowatts. Holden won torque, airbags and price.

_sources: CarAdvice '2008 Ford FG Falcon XR8 specifications': 5.4-litre quad-cam Boss 290 V8, 290 kW / 520 Nm

GoAuto FG Falcon XR8 sedan launch review (10 Apr 2008): 5.4 DOHC Boss V8, six-speed manual (six-speed ZF auto optional); XR8 has 20 kW more and 10 Nm less than the Commodore SS; SS $200 cheaper; SS has six airbags vs XR8's four
GoAuto (10 Apr 2008) describes the SS's 6.0 as a Gen IV V8 (GM's pushrod small-block family) and the XR8's Boss 290 as DOHC
Carsales 'FG Falcon drops almost $3000 into Aussie pockets' (14 Apr 2008): Falcon XR8 manual $45,490; Commodore SS $45,290, 270 kW / 530 Nm
Carsales 'Ford FG Falcon XR6, XR6 Turbo and XR8' review (11 Apr 2008): XR8 $45,490, 290 kW / 520 Nm
Prices are April 2008 list prices before on-roads
